about: Addos XR (sustained-release nifedipine) is supplied five times from March to July 2026 for a woman aged 75, by brand name only.
Nifedipine (APO-Nifedipine XR) is supplied three times in the middle of a 14-month history for a man aged 68.
Plendil ER (felodipine, a similar calcium channel blocker) is supplied monthly. It is not on the list, so nothing must flag.
